text: Space is very big, and it is full of amazing things. The universe has millions of stars, planets, and galaxies. Our planet, Earth, moves around the sun, and the moon moves around the Earth. At night, you can look up at the sky and see the moon and many bright stars. Scientists use a telescope to look at stars and planets that are far away. The distance between Earth and other planets is very large. To explore space, people build big rockets. An astronaut travels into space inside a rocket. In space, there is very little gravity, so astronauts float instead of walking. Some astronauts have a special mission to land on the moon or study a planet. We also use a satellite in space. A satellite can orbit the Earth and send information back to us, like weather news or TV signals. Space travel is difficult and expensive, but people want to explore it because there is still so much we don't know about the universe. Maybe one day, people will land on another planet and start a new life there.
